system_prompt_style.note: EVIDENCE MISMATCH: the bundled paper (arXiv 2512.23646, OmniAgent audio-video agent) describes a different system from the pinned repo (Omnigent meta-harness). Every cell codes the repo, per rule 1. No line numbers are available in the bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Enables local OS tools such as file reads, writes, edits, and shell commands.
env_context_strategy.note: Context strategy is largely delegated to the wrapped harness (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

context_compaction.note: No history-processing code was in the bundle. The meta-harness delegates to the wrapped harnesses.

observation_format.note: No observation conversion code was in the bundle.

tool_call_format.note: The parser depends on the wrapped harness. No parser code was in the bundle.

tool_count.note: The default tool list was not visible in the bundle.

edit_primitive.note: The os_env 'edits' tool is mentioned but its primitive is not shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: A local Python function (schema auto-generated from the signature)
tool_schema_source.note: Hand-written `parameters` schema is shown in the function-tool example in docs/AGENT_YAML_SPEC.md. MCP tools come via `type: mcp`.

protocol_standardization.note: MCP comes via `type: mcp` tools; `other` = ACP.

loop_primitives.note: No run loop code was in the bundle. The loop is owned by the wrapped harnesses. The paper's Think-Act-Observe-Reflect loop belongs to a different system.

planning_granularity.note: The Polly example 'plans' in prose. No plan object was seen.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: `omnigent` picks a model with you and starts a session in your terminal.
multi_agent_topology.note: orchestrator_workers is reachable via `type: agent` sub-agents (Polly example). Debby's /debate mode is debate-like.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A sub-agent the supervisor can delegate to
delegation_mechanism.note: The default is none. subagent_spawn is opt-in via `type: agent` tools in agent YAML.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: They check every action and either allow it, block it, or pause to ask you first.
human_in_loop.note: Policies are selectable at server, agent and session level.

short_term_state.note: No state object code was in the bundle.

long_term_memory.note: The 'Storage and memory: s3, hindsight' extras are listed but their mechanism is not shown.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Sessions follow you: start in your terminal, continue in the browser, pick it up on your phone.
state_persistence.note: Fork from session_id is also supported. The code path was not seen.

self_verification.evidence_quote: then routes each diff to a reviewer from a different vendor than the one that wrote it
self_verification.note: Config-reachable via reviewer sub-agents (Polly example). There is no default verification.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: limit: 50 # cap how many tools one session can call
termination_condition.note: Both come via opt-in builtin policies (max_tool_calls_per_session, cost_budget). The model_declared stop is harness-owned and not shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: omit it and Omnigent picks the platform default (`linux_bwrap` on Linux, `darwin_seatbelt` on macOS, or `windows_jobobject` on Windows)
execution_isolation.note: The default is an OS-sandboxed host process (bwrap/seatbelt), which is the closest value. Cloud sandboxes (Modal, E2B, ...) and containers are reachable.

filesystem_access.note: Scoped relative to the host process via sandbox write_paths.

network_policy.note: The allowlist is reachable via sandbox egress_rules (L7 proxy).

permission_model.evidence_quote: Policies stack across three levels, **server-wide** (admin), **per-agent** (developer), and **per-session** (you)
permission_model.note: The default active policy set is not shown.

tracing.note: designs/OBSERVABILITY.md is listed but its content was not in the bundle.

eval_hooks.note: Only a harness capability test bench and perf benchmarks are listed. The paper's benchmarks belong to a different system.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Policies can inspect requests, responses, tool calls, and tool results.

target_domain.evidence_quote: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents
